question: Which wheel forms may the undivided mind meditate upon?
premises: The wheel may have sixty-four hundred ara.
The wheel may have thousand ara.
inference: Meditation may take several wheel forms, including countless thousand ara.
uncertainties: sahasrāramathāpi is treated as one token in the supplied list.
plain_english: Or the sixty-four-hundred-ara wheel, or the thousand-ara wheel, or the countless-thousand-ara wheel, the one of undivided mind should meditate.
